note: [F] Deicyde/diophantine-z-q, proved: nonzero_indicator proves the mask equation determines N_j, branch_split the split into nonzero and zero branch histories, and indicator_digits the zero-one digits of the indicators; proved, no assumed hypothesis.

snippet.text:
theorem nonzero_indicator {c q K B F D : ℕ} (_hc : 0 < c) (hK : K = 2 ^ c) (hB : B = 4 * K)
    (hF : F = ∑ t ∈ range (q + 1), B ^ t) (hD : D = (K - 1) * F) (ρ : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hρ : ∀ t ≤ q, ρ t < K) :
    Nat.land (∑ t ∈ range (q + 1), ρ t * B ^ t + D) (K * F) =
        K * ∑ t ∈ range (q + 1), (if 0 < ρ t then 1 else 0) * B ^ t ∧
      ∀ N, K * N = Nat.land (∑ t ∈ range (q + 1), ρ t * B ^ t + D) (K * F) ↔
        N = ∑ t ∈ range (q + 1), (if 0 < ρ t then 1 else 0) * B ^ t := by
